title: Slovakian Lamb Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian-inspired casserole made with tender lamb and topped with a crispy crust.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, caraway seeds, and paprika.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the lamb for 2.5 hours, or until tender.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the casserole topping by mixing together 1 cup of breadcrumbs and 1/4 cup of grated cheese.
Remove the pot from the oven and top the lamb with the casserole topping.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
Let the casserole rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
